sekcje: Drug Levels and Effects > Summary of Use during Lactation

No information is available on the clinical use of trypan blue during breastfeeding. Breastfeeding is not expected to result in exposure of the child to trypan blue due to the negligible systemic exposure of trypan blue in humans following injection and subsequent removal of the drug at the completion of surgical procedures.
